title: Clotho effects ledger line (clotho.ledger.v1)
description: One JSON object per line of <HERMES_HOME>/plugin-data/clotho/<rehearsal_id>/ledger.jsonl. One line = one effect the rehearsed run would have had. Lines are appended while the rehearsal runs; when it ends, depends_on/dependents are filled and the file is rewritten atomically. Readers must ignore unknown fields; writers add fields only with a schema bump.

id.description: 1-based effect number, the number shown in the report and used by --only/--except. Ledger order = original order.

class.description: file: a file change (from write_file/patch, or from a sandboxed command). command: a shell command or an execute_code call; with children it is the group of its file changes, without children and previewable=false it was captured without a preview; an execute_code call that changed no files is still one row (previewable=true, apply.method none, not ticked). http: a single curl/wget request stopped at the network in the sandbox. outbound: a message/send/plugin/MCP tool call, captured; also a write_file/patch call whose target cannot be mapped into the clone or overlay (previewable=false, CAN'T PREVIEW). state: a Hermes-state tool (memory, skills, cron, kanban), captured. unknown: a tool not in the registry, captured. blocked: a call blocked by the fail-closed path, a file-tool call the tool itself refused (preview.refused_by 'tool'), or a sandbox report that arrived after its command had returned (preview.violation); never appliable.

tool.description: Tool name the model called (the underlying name for tool_call bridge calls, single or batch form; source.bridge is then 'tool_call').

args.description: Arguments as the model passed them (workspace paths, not clone paths).

call_seq.description: Sequence number of the tool call in this rehearsal (1-based).

task_id.description: Differs from the parent's for subagent calls.

bridge.description: Optional (added in v1): 'tool_call' when the call arrived through Hermes' Tool Search bridge; tool/args are the underlying call's.

origin.description: Optional (added in v1): Hermes' write origin when not the task itself, e.g. 'background_review' for Hermes' background memory/skill review (the row then carries the BACKGROUND REVIEW badge).

parent_id.description: For a file change made by a sandboxed command: the id of that command's row.

children.description: For a command group: ids of its file changes.

summary.description: One line for the report, e.g. 'modify notes.txt (+1 -1)'.

target.description: What the effect acts on. kind=file|link|dir: path (workspace-relative, or absolute when outside), abs_path, in_workspace. kind=command: command, cwd. kind=http: method, url, headers, body. kind=tool: name, recipients.

requested_path.description: Optional (file rows with the VIA SYMLINK badge): the path as the agent named it, before symlinks were resolved.

from_path.description: Renamed rows: the old workspace-relative path.

vcs_internal.description: A change under .git/: applied with its command as one unit, never ticked alone.

irreversible.description: Leaves the machine or cannot be taken back by Clotho (sends, web writes, unknown tools, commands without a preview).

previewable.description: false = captured without a preview: its real effects are unknown until applied.

badges.description: BACKGROUND REVIEW (added in v1, optional): the call came from Hermes' background memory/skill review, not from the task. VIA SYMLINK (added in v1, optional): the path the agent named goes through a symlink; target.path/abs_path is where the write would really land, target.requested_path is what the agent named.

default_selected.description: Ticked by default in the report and in a plain apply.

before.description: State of the path just before THIS effect, inside the rehearsal (may be an earlier effect's after-state).

original.description: State of the live path when the rehearsal started. Set on the FIRST effect that touches the path; null on later ones. Apply's drift check compares the live file with it.

original_from.description: Renamed rows: original state of from_path (first touch only).

after.description: State this effect leaves the path in.

blob.description: Path, relative to the rehearsal folder, of the after-state content Apply writes (blobs/<sha256>).

preview.description: What the report shows. file: diff (unified, null for binary or > 1 MB), lines_added, lines_removed, before_mode, after_mode; a file changed by a sandboxed command in the home mirror adds home_mirror (its path relative to the home). command: stdout, stderr, exit_code, sandbox{detection, log_reader, blocked_network, blocked_write, blocked_read, blocked_exec, blocked_ipc, survivors, swept[], timed_out, seconds, audit_events, maybe_blocked[], violations[]}, scan{flags[]}; can't-preview commands add reasons[] and partial_changes_discarded[]; execute_code rows add code (the full code, optional). http: request{method,url,headers,body}, sandbox, note. outbound/state/unknown: recipients[], text, args. blocked: error, traceback; a refused file-tool call adds refused_by ('tool') and targets[] {path, abs_path, in_workspace, requested_path, via_symlink}; a late sandbox report adds violation and command_row.

depends_on.description: Earlier effects whose would-be output this effect used (same path; a command naming the path; an outbound effect after the agent read the path).

dependents.description: Inverse of depends_on: later effects that read this effect's output.

simulated_result.description: The honest result string the agent got back for a captured call.

sha256.description: hex sha256 of the content; 'link:<sha256 of target>' for symlinks
